pricing.subtitle: No generic packages, no fine print. We design the exact plan you need and adapt it to your goals.
pricing.pain1Title: You pay for packages that don't fit
pricing.pain1Desc: You sign up for a generic plan and end up paying for services your business doesn't even need.
pricing.pain2Title: You don't know if it's working
pricing.pain2Desc: Money goes out every month, but no one shows you clearly what's driving sales and what isn't.
pricing.pain3Title: Every vendor does their own thing
pricing.pain3Desc: Social, ads, web, and CRM sit with different people who don't talk to each other — and you pay the price of that disconnect.
pricing.valueTitle: A full team of experts at your service.
pricing.valueDesc: We start with a free audit of your brand. From there we build a plan that combines exactly the services you need — not one more — and work with total transparency before a single dollar moves.
pricing.benefit1Desc: No prebuilt packages — every service is chosen based on what your business actually needs.
pricing.benefit2Desc: You know exactly what you're paying and why, before you sign anything.
pricing.benefit3Desc: Clear reporting from day 1 that connects every campaign to real sales.
pricing.benefit4Desc: We adjust the plan as your business grows — no contracts that lock you in.
pricing.testimonialsTitle: Businesses that already amplified their signal.
pricing.faq1Q: How is the price calculated without fixed packages?
pricing.faq1A: During the free audit we review your brand, your channels, and your goals. From that we build a plan with the exact services you need and give you a fixed price — no surprises later.
pricing.faq2Q: Do I have to sign a long contract?
pricing.faq2A: No. We work with flexible plans you can adjust or pause as your business needs change.
pricing.faq3Q: What happens if I don't see results?
pricing.faq3A: You get clear reporting from month one so you can see exactly what's working. If something isn't delivering, we adjust the strategy — we don't wait until the end of the quarter to react.
pricing.faq4Q: Does this work for small businesses or only big brands?
pricing.faq4A: Both. The plan is built around your budget and goals, so a small business pays for what it needs today — not what a brand ten times its size would need.
pricing.faq5Q: How long until I see results?
pricing.faq5A: It depends on the channel: paid advertising usually shows movement within the first few weeks; SEO and organic content take longer but deliver more sustainable results. We lay this out clearly during the audit.
pricing.finalCtaDesc: Book your free 30-minute audit and walk out with a clear plan — and a price that makes sense for your business.
